parameters.jsCode: const body=$input.first().json; if(body.username!=='xianjiawei.tw'||String(body.user_id)!=='17841478328163000') throw new Error('Official Instagram account identity not verified'); return [{json:{platform:'instagram',accountId:String(body.user_id),username:body.username,identityVerified:true,mode:'read_only',sent:false,commentPermissionVerified:false,e2eVerified:false}}];

nodes.name: 確認正式帳號與不發送狀態

parameters.jsCode: const b=$input.first().json; if(!Array.isArray(b.data)) throw new Error('Invalid media response'); // Metricool's read-only feed metric (2026-09-19) reported one comment at this permalink. // That aggregate is NOT proof the official Meta API grants comment text access. const target='https://www.instagram.com/p/Dddia2NFGXr/'; const norm=p=>String(p||'').split('?')[0].replace(/\/$/,'')+'/'; const candidates=b.data.filter(p=>typeof p.id==='string'&&p.id&&Number.isFinite(Number(p.comments_count))&&Number(p.comments_count)>0); const known=candidates.filter(p=>norm(p.permalink)===target); const others=candidates.filter(p=>norm(p.permalink)!==target); const posts=[...known,...others].slice(0,3); if(!posts.length) throw new Error('No commented media in sampled page; comment permission not verified'); return posts.map(p=>({json:{mediaId:String(p.id),commentsCount:Number(p.comments_count),   targetPostFromMetricool:norm(p.permalink)===target,mediaPaginationRemaining:!!b.paging?.next}}));

return $input.all().map((item)=>{ const b=item.json; if(!Array.isArray(b.data)) throw new Error('Invalid comments response'); const replies=b.data.flatMap(c=>c.replies?.data||[]); const remaining=!!b.paging?.next||b.data.some(c=>!!c.replies?.paging?.next); return {json:{platform:'instagram',mode:'read_only',commentsEndpointResponded:true,commentReadVerified:b.data.some(c=>typeof c.text==='string'&&!!c.id),commentsRead:b.data.length,repliesRead:replies.length,brandRepliesRead:replies.filter(r=>r.username==='xianjiawei.tw').length,paginationRemaining:remaining,completeHistoryVerified:false,humanAttributionVerified:false,replyPermissionVerified:false,sent:false,e2eVerified:false}}; });
